args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 3.1.0 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 3.1.0 in `requirements.txt` to address **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.

- Affected: fastjson <2.9.4, >=3.0.0 <3.1.0
- Fix taken on the 3.x line (3.1.0), consistent with the fastjson 3.x migration completed last sprint

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `13fee7191e`: **passed**

Requesting review from @alex.
